sentences.en: Elia Kazan, who could be as passionate, difficult and dictatorial as any of his peers, will live on primarily through the images of a handful of actors.

sentences.en: If we decide to sell Elia then we have to get the necessary funds in to buy two or three new players.

sentences.en: Eljero Elia for Kuyt, Cesc Fabregas for Alonso, Rafael van der Vaart for de Jong were all positive moves, and contributed to the game becoming more open and attractive in the second period.
